description:
Compute one arithmetic expression and return the result. Only numbers, + - * / // % **, parentheses and signs; no functions (abs, sqrt), no variables. Changes nothing. Examples:
- {"expr": "17*23"} -> 391
- {"expr": "(2+3)**2 // 4"} -> 6
Errors: ExprBad (anything it cannot compute, e.g. 1/0 or sqrt(2)), ArgumentsBad.
